name: gearbox
description: Picks model and effort for each subagent with Laya, a local decision model, and shows every subagent in a pane with its model, effort, tokens, estimated cost and files. Observes by default (logs its pick and how the agent ended, /gearbox report sums it up); in apply mode it starts subagents on the model and effort it picks

ollama.title: Ollama executable
ollama.description: Path to the ollama executable. A desktop app may not see your shell's PATH: give the full path then, for example /opt/homebrew/bin/ollama.

model.title: Laya model
model.description: The name of the Laya model in Ollama.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: observe: log what gearbox would pick and change nothing. apply: start each subagent on the model gearbox picks, unless the caller named one, and run it at the effort gearbox picks.

retentionDays.title: Keep logs (days)
retentionDays.description: Logs of other sessions older than this are removed at the start of a session. 0 keeps them all.

notify.title: Notify when an agent ends
notify.description: on: a notice says when a subagent finishes, how it ended and how long it ran. off: the pane alone shows it.

clearAfterMinutes.title: Clear finished agents after (minutes)
clearAfterMinutes.description: A finished subagent leaves the pane this many minutes after it ends. 0 keeps it until clear or /clear.
